守望相助（守望相助（第22页）不过他终究也要出上一份力的，就算力有不逮多失误，也不能吝啬助威喝彩话。“兄长厉害，就这么打，唯我大日常明、不避山海泥偶。”“诶？那位兄长怎么出工不出力，快快加把力，我们能赢得。”“不好，三哥你怎么坠空了，再坚持一下，我已看到未来，胜利就在眼前。”在长乐小僧的鼓舞下，九大阳乌很快就栽了一个。此绝非他不卖力，而是敌人太狡猾，额外关照一只鸟。坏消息是，那只阳乌长乐小僧也打过，回头定会施展甩锅法，将他抓起来据理力争，陈述千里之堤溃于蚁穴的道理。好消息是，那只阳乌长乐小僧真打过，就算暂时战败了，也留下了一枚金色光球祭奠他们之间的真挚情义。可惜如见局势未明，葫芦藤网、万千泥偶也太过严密，不好立刻拾取掉落光球，为其诵经祈福收敛失物。“六哥，我又看到了未来···”“闭嘴，回头定要把小十换上来，不要你这碎嘴僧。”“万万不可，小十是我亲兄弟，我不忍心让他来受这份苦。还是让我代他受难吧，只要他能享太平，我受些磨难算什么。”“···，你何曾见他辛苦？你又承了几分磨难，难道受累的不是我们兄弟吗？”“别这么说，痛在你身、伤在我心，我们兄弟此时在一同承受痛苦，绝无一人不同心。”“你个老六···”系统提示连续响起，不良之鸟已然暴露。正所谓心中无瑕、不见瑕，斑驳之镜照污迹，老六陆珺定是心中不净，才见长乐不同。“···，修我闭口禅，不理争斗心。”长乐小僧之前还赞叹老大伯瑝有德行，谁知转眼就被其背刺。这简直太令人伤心了，看来只有小十靠得住，暂时不会为何从众而打击损友。可即便如此，长乐小僧也没有放弃感化不良法，见谁坠空都呼喊，声声凄厉震山海。许是被他真情感动，一场大战之后竟是阳乌残胜十神落败，可见九曜本源更充沛，即便有所不足，也能消耗得胜。

Watch and help each other (Watch and help each other (page 22)) But he has to do his part after all. Even if he is unable to catch up with many mistakes, he cannot be stingy with words of encouragement and cheers. "Brother is great, just fight like this. I am the only one who is clear and will not avoid mountains and seas." "Eh? How come that brother can't do his job well? , hurry up and work harder, we can win." "No, third brother, why did you fall into the air? Just hold on, I have seen the future, and victory is right in front of me." Encouraged by the little monk in Changle, Jiuda Yangwu quickly fell. This is not because he is not working hard, but because the enemy is too cunning and needs extra care. Bird. The bad news is that the young monk Yangwu Changle has also beaten him. He will definitely use the blame-breaking method to catch him and argue with him to explain why the embankment of a thousand miles collapsed in the ant nest. The good news is that the young monk Yangwu Changle has beaten him. Even if he is temporarily defeated, he will leave a golden ball of light as a memorial. The sincere friendship between them. Unfortunately, if the situation is not clear, the gourd vine net and thousands of clay dolls are too tight to pick up the fallen light ball immediately, pray for it and collect the lost property. "Brother Six, I saw the future again..." "Shut up, and I will replace Xiao Shi when I turn around. Don't let me be so broken." "No way, Xiao Shi is my brother. I can't bear to let him suffer this. As long as he can enjoy peace, it doesn't matter if I suffer." "Don't say that. The pain is in your body and in my heart. We brothers are suffering together at this time, and no one of us disagrees." "You old six..." The system prompts continue to sound, and the bad bird has been exposed. As the saying goes, there is no flaw in the heart, and the mottled mirror reflects the stains. Lu Jun must have an impure heart, so he saw that Changle was different. "..., practice my silent words and ignore the fighting spirit." Changle's young monk had praised the elder Bohui for his virtue before, but he was stabbed in the back in the blink of an eye. It seems that only Xiao Shi is reliable and will not be beaten for the sake of following the crowd. Even so, the young monk of Changle did not give up on the bad method. He shouted when he saw anyone falling into the air, and his voice was so loud that it shook the mountains and seas. Perhaps he was moved by his true feelings. After a battle, Yang Wu Can Sheng Sheng was defeated. This shows that Jiu Yao's source is more abundant, and even if it is lacking, it can still be used to win.
